title: KAITO — Icy Quarrel〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I... I just need a little bit more time...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (This is a situation where you suffer more the longer you let this linger. And yet...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
(What is it that Mizuki's dealing with...?
Is it really that sensitive a matter?)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hm...? There's something floating on the lake's surface.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
What is this? A flower...?
No, it's an accessory shaped like a flower...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Where have I seen this before?
Also, why is it appearing here...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO's Voice
rows.Line: Are you sure you dropped it here?

rows.Speaker: Rin's Voice
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I for sure had it on before coming to the lake.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I also believe that we'd find it here.
Oh, KAITO...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm free to go wherever I please.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: More importantly, what are you all doing here?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We're helping Rin look for something...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I decided to wear it for the first time in a while, but then I lost it...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Thank you for finding it, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It's not like I did it for her.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I just saw it floating on the surface of the lake and picked it up out of curiosity.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
On the surface of the lake...?
It didn't sink?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If this were an ordinary lake, then the corsage would invariably have sunk to the bottom.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: This lake has some sort of deep connection to Mafuyu's feelings.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That also goes for the various things that appear to be at the bottom.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So... When Rin tried to put the corsage back on, it suddenly fell off...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Rin, let me see that...
If the pin attaching the flower just came loose, then I may be able to fix it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Again, I didn't do it for you...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thanking him like that proves that you're the mature one, Rin. Anyway, here you are. It should be fixed now...
